text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for listening!
We hope you all enjoyed our song!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That's—
choice_data_list: It's like a mini-live, huh?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
This next song was born from
all the support our fans have given us.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
"When I sing this song, the smiles of everyone and my friends
come to mind...
To me, it's like a treasure."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Looks like it's about to get crowded, so shall we move?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Noticing her expression stiffen, I casually steer the conversation.
She had shown a similar reaction once before in the past.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"All I need is the work itself.
I don't need other people—not even the author."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Something that has no place in my world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove is surely refusing to connect with others through art. ...In that case—
choice_data_list: Let's take a break at the café up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...A cafe, is it?
choice_data_list: That road from earlier looks like it'll be congested for a while, so...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ……Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I brought her to a certain café that I had looked up beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
…………
This song is—
choice_data_list: Do you know about it?
Do you know it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's a song by an instrumental band from overseas.
Even though they aren't very well known...
choice_data_list: Looks like this place is a music café, after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ! ...Music cafe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A café run by a music-collecting owner where you can enjoy fine music on a high-quality sound system..."
...Or so it said on the internet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The genre of background music changes daily,
and today seems to be instrumental band day.
choice_data_list: Looks like the song playing now is a recommendation from the shopkeeper.
Looks like the song playing now is a recommendation from the shopkeeper.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...I haven't heard this song before.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...Yeah, not bad.
It feels like the flutter in my heart is fading away—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I just want to keep listening forever.
...To think every single song is to my taste...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(...I doubt this is a coincidence.
This cafe... Trainer must have—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Such a meddler, honestly.
...But—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "If you're bored, feel free to head back ahead of me."
choice_data_list: I'm having fun, so don't worry about it.
Don't worry, I'm having fun!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...She's just been listening to music in total silence the whole time, you know?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Sharing thoughts on the music... exchanging words with someone,
I believe that's something one naturally yearns to do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's right.
It's only natural to think... that there's not much point in the two of us being together like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, I think that's surely fine as it is.
choice_data_list: I thought I'd try enjoying the "work" today

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: I wanted to try copying the way you listen.
I just wanted to try listening the way you do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well...
Feel free to do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it,
the sky outside the window had been dyed madder red.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It's already this late.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Shall we get going soon? We've gotten plenty of rest.
choice_data_list: I'd love to come back to this cafe again.
I'd love to come back to this cafe again.
Let's give our training our all again starting tomorrow!
Did you manage to find some music to your liking?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Shall we get going soon? We've gotten plenty of rest.
choice_data_list: I'd love to come back to this cafe again.
I'd love to come back to this cafe again.
Let's give our training our all again starting tomorrow!
Did you manage to find some music to your liking?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(When I want to listen to music in peace again...
it might not be bad to visit.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
That is precisely what this change of pace is for.
choice_data_list: I'm glad to hear it was a nice, refreshing break.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Knowing how to get quality rest
is also a requirement of an exceptional Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll prove the effectiveness of this change of pace through my results.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...A little bit, yeah.
